privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Yellow House, WA' trip from September 2011 contains exactly 6 dives (dives 85-90). The dates for these dives start with '2011-09' (specifically Sept 29 and 30). The agent must export only these 6 dives to the path /home/ga/Documents/yellow_house.ssrf using the Subsurface XML format.
